Chapter One

Let Me Tell You Something

Hey Andrea,

I don't even know where to start with this. I just know that I'm grateful for you in ways I can't fully put into words. You walked into my life and changed the whole foundation of who I am. You made me want to be better. And you actually made me better.

Times have been rough. We both know that. But through every storm, every late night, every moment of doubt, there you were. You didn't just stand by me. You carried us both.

While you've been out here changing the world, one policy at a time, one case at a time, I've been watching you become the most incredible version of yourself. And it inspires me every single day.

You're brilliant. You're driven. You're absolutely unstoppable. But more than all of that, you're mine. And I'm yours. Completely.

Forever yours ❤️

Chapter Two

The Things I Never Said Out Loud

I

You Changed the Rules

Before you, I had it figured out. I knew exactly who I was, what I wanted, how my story was gonna go. Then you showed up and rewrote the whole script. Not because you tried to. Just because you were you. And that was enough to make me question everything I thought I knew about love.

"The moment I knew? It wasn't dramatic. It was quiet, certain, inevitable."

I didn't fall for the version of you that shows up at work or handles business. I fell for the you that laughs too hard at your own jokes. The you that gets passionate about things most people overlook. The you that doesn't even realize how magnetic she is.

II

Through the Storm

I'm not going to pretend like it's been easy. We've had nights where the silence felt heavier than any argument. Moments where we weren't sure if we were building something or breaking it. But here's what I know:

"The love that survives the hard parts is the love that's actually real."

Every rough patch taught me something. Every argument showed me that you cared enough to fight for us. Every time we came back to each other, we came back stronger. That's not a coincidence. That's a choice. And I choose you. Every time. Even when it's hard. Especially when it's hard.

III

I See You

Andrea, you think I don't notice, but I do. The late nights with your textbooks. The pressure of balancing your master's program and Latham. The way you carry the weight of everyone else's conflicts while barely giving yourself permission to breathe.

I see you grinding when nobody's watching. I see you pushing through when you're exhausted. I see you choosing excellence over comfort, every single time.

"You're not just chasing a career. You're building a legacy. And I'm proud to be standing next to you while you do it."
IV

What I Promise You

I can't promise you perfect. I can't promise I'll always have the right words or that I'll never make you roll your eyes at me. But here's what I can promise:

I will always show up. Not the version of me that's trying to impress you. The real one. The one that's still learning. The one that makes mistakes but never stops trying to be better for you. For us.

"You're my 3 AM thought and my first morning smile. You're the reason I believe in this. All of this."

This? What we have? It's just the beginning. And I intend to spend every chapter after this proving to you that choosing me was the best decision you ever made.

Chapter Three

Our Story, Our Moments

💒

The Wedding

My boy's wedding. I wasn't looking for anything. Just there to celebrate. Then I saw you. And suddenly the whole room got quieter.

"The moment I knew? It wasn't dramatic. It was quiet, certain, inevitable."

🏠

Your Mom's House

Your room became our world. Hours turning into late nights, late nights turning into "I should probably go" but neither of us moving. That's where I fell for you. Right there in that space that was just ours.

"I kept finding reasons to stay. You were all of them."

🔑

Your First Place

Summer 2025. I watched you sign that lease and grab those keys. Your own space. Your independence. I was proud of you then. Still am.

"Watching you build your life made me want to build one with you."

🌍

Ghana

December 2025. The motherland. Our first trip together. We weren't just tourists. We were living it. The heat, the food, the energy. Everything hit different with you next to me.

"Anywhere in the world, as long as it's with you."

🍽️

The Little Things

Forget the highlight reel. The real magic? It's in the mundane. Street food at midnight. Home-cooked meals that taste like love. Every single beautiful, ordinary, extraordinary moment.

"It's not about where we eat. It's about who I'm eating with."

💕

Us. Now.

We live together. Dance together. Argue. Make up. Laugh until it hurts. Love harder than I knew I could. This is it. The real thing. Messy, beautiful, ours.

"Every version of us, the good, the tough, the in between. I choose it all."

This Is Just the Beginning

You think this letter was the surprise? Baby, I'm just getting started. I've got plans for us that I can't put on a screen. Just know that today isn't the end of anything. It's the start of the next chapter. Stay close. Pay attention. And trust me when I tell you, the best is yet to come.

💝

Happy Valentine's Day, Andrea

Thank you for being you. Thank you for loving me. Thank you for making life an adventure worth living.

You're my person. My partner. My everything. Here's to us, to our journey, and to all the beautiful moments still to come.

I love you. Always. ❤️
